name: D-Cut Plain Carry Bag
note: Our highest volume line. Plain 60 GSM fabric, U/D-cut handle, stocked in white and cream — usually dispatched within two days.

name: D-Cut Printed Carry Bag
note: One to three colour screen printing on both sides. Send your logo in any format — we redraw it free for print.

name: W-Cut Plain Carry Bag
note: Gusseted W-cut shape opens wide and stands on the counter. Cheapest per bag of everything we make.

name: Loop Handle Stitched Bag
note: Stitched body with a sewn loop handle — carries 8 to 12 kg. Handle colour can be matched to your brand.

name: Stitched Bag with Side Patty
note: Side patty adds depth so folded sarees and lehengas sit flat. Our most premium plain bag.

name: Stitched Side Patty, Printed
note: Full surface print on the front panel with a plain contrast side patty. Best seller for wedding season orders.

name: 12×16 Single Colour Printed Bag
note: Single colour black print on white fabric — the most economical printed option for small shops.

name: Digital Printed Loop Handle Bag
note: Laminated full colour digital print with coloured handles. Photographs, gradients and fine Telugu type all reproduce cleanly.

name: Full Surface Print Loop Bag
note: Dark full surface print on 100 GSM fabric. Heavier fabric holds the ink flat with no show-through.

name: Two Colour Printed D-Cut Bag
note: Two colour print — typically shop name in one colour and address strip in another.

name: Family Store Printed Bag
note: Larger D-cut used by family clothing stores for two-piece sets.

name: Laminated Photo Print Shopping Bag
note: Glossy lamination over full colour print. Wipe-clean surface, reused by customers for months.

name: Sweet Shop Box Bag
note: Box shape with a flat base for 0.5 kg and 1 kg sweet boxes. Food safe fabric.

name: Seed Packing Printed Bag
note: Front panel brand print with a reverse panel for crop, batch and lot details. Stitched for weight.

name: Telugu Full Colour Loop Bag
note: Telugu and English type set together, printed full colour. We proof the Telugu spelling with you before printing.

name: Floral Print Flat Carry Bag
note: Flat bag with an all-over floral print — popular for kids wear and small gift shops.
